description: AI-generated photographic-style covers, revised to reduce highlights and glare.

assets.photographicRevisionPrompt: Replace this rejected game cover with a genuinely photographic, physically plausible motorsport image. Preserve only the wide 2.19:1 banner layout and space for a later title, NOT the fantasy montage. One continuous real-world scene, taken by an actual sports photographer: pit garage at a racing circuit, one normal-sized adult racing driver wearing a plain red fireproof suit and a properly proportioned helmet, seated inside the cockpit of a modern unbranded red single-seat open-wheel race car. Driver and car occupy right 60 percent, real garage shadows and subtle out-of-focus pit equipment on the left, asphalt and garage geometry consistent. Natural overcast daylight from open garage door, realistic carbon fiber, scuffs on tires, modest reflections, neutral documentary color grading, 50mm lens, believable human anatomy and scale. Absolutely no giant head, no floating helmet, no layered portrait collage, no skyline montage, no flags or dragon decorations, no light trails, no fire, no fantasy clouds, no glossy CGI or illustration. No text, logo, sponsor name or watermark. This must feel like a candid authentic racetrack photograph, suitable for a serious driver career game. Wide landscape.
assets.finalEditPrompt: Make a restrained photographic tonal edit to this exact cover image. Preserve the composition, subject, framing, geometry, all objects and the wide aspect ratio exactly. The user wants LESS HIGHLIGHT and LESS GLARE. Lower bright specular highlights by about 35–45 percent, softly roll off whites, reduce the shiny reflections on paint, glass, floor and bright outdoor areas. Keep midtones and shadow detail readable, do not simply darken the whole image. Natural soft diffuse illumination, matte photographic finish, neutral slightly muted color, lower microcontrast, no HDR shine or glow. Maintain genuine realistic photographic texture, no illustration filter, no added elements, no text. Output same composition and dimensions.
